subject: Beta1 V2 full CI passed but runtime push was safely rejected; use this window to revise payload
body: GitHub Actions run 36981573600 passed exact-baseline verification, support checksums, patch application, invariant validation, focused Gen5/regression tests, and the full testFullDebugUnitTest + assembleFullDebug gate. The job then created local ephemeral commit 369ab14 (11 files, 938 insertions / 175 deletions) but remote push was rejected because the GitHub App token lacks workflows permission and the runtime commit included .github/workflows/build-shizuku-apk.yml. No runtime commit reached main and no APK was published. MANAGER_RECOMMENDATION: do not solve this merely by broadening workflow permissions or retrying V2 unchanged. Decouple obsolete historical-workflow cleanup from the Gen5 runtime commit (or perform it through a separately authorized path), and use this safe failure window to fold in the already-routed five source-confirmed fixes: real preferred FrameTimeline timing/measured cadence, API35 FoldView frame-rate request plus seamless surface vote, attempt/host-fenced refresh lease with old-host revocation, truly independent Gen5 glass control, and strict cached-inner snapshot provenance/freshness. Current remote main remains support-only until a new commit is observed. No Manager production writes.
